messages:
Samir: FYI got an urgent invoice from Nebula Labs but there's no PO on it. Invoice NL-2134 for $12,300. Vendor is pressing for payment — says it's tied to contract renewal. Can AP match?
Invoices Bot: Invoice NL-2134 scanned and added to AP queue. Status: Pending PO match.
Rachel: I checked their email thread — vendor says PO was sent but not in our system. @Lucas any chance purchasing has a PO for Nebula?
Lucas: We used to have PO RWD-2023-112 but that expired. No active PO for Nebula in Coupa. Approver on vendor form is Clara (she left last month). I can draft a new PO but need the contract code.
Anya: Contract code is `NET-NEB-04`. Legal can sign off on a new PO if it's within scope. @Marcos needs to approve budget-wise.
Samir: Marcos is OOO until Monday. Can we route to his backup? Who's the budget owner backup?
Priya: I9m listed as Marcos' backup for Engineering vendor approvals. I can approve up to $15k. Add me as approver and I9ll take it. :thumbsup:
Lucas: Drafted PO RWD-2024-821 and attached to draft in AP. Linked it to invoice NL-2134 in the system. Ticket TKT-3245 created. Added Priya as approver. Samir, can you confirm invoice lines vs contract?
Samir: Quick check — vendor billed an "implementation fee" of $2,000 that isn't in the signed SOW. Need vendor confirmation or credit.
Rachel: Pinged Nebula rep Mark. He replied: "We can either credit $2,000 or issue a corrected invoice — will send corrected invoice by EOD." I'll update TKT-3245 once we get it. :white_check_mark:
Invoices Bot: Invoice NL-2134 status updated: Pending PO match -> Ready for approval (pending PO attachment).
Priya: I will approve as soon as the corrected invoice or credit memo is attached.
Samir: Great — marking as HIGH priority for month-end. @Accounting please note possible accrual change if credit issued. Closing loop once we have the corrected invoice or a credit memo.
